levels: Beds 0.13–0.17 under narration with 15–20-frame fades (skill voice-and-audio.md §6; ChapterShell does this). Default bed 0.15.
Cold open 0.17, dipping at the end (Reform: to 0.06; Grip Tighter: to 0.12; King Andrew: to 0).
Title sting 0.45, starting 4 frames before the '15' (fade 0→0.45 in 3 frames, hold to frame 50, out by frame 74). War Nobody Won title_fanfare 0.45–0.5.
Heavy chapters: a grave cue at ~0.12 or near-silence ('near-silence is a choice, not a gap').

ElevenLabs King Andrew cues are quieter than the Lyria cues: Ouija runs j_good_feelings / j_gossip / j_cold_open / r_intrigue(j_intrigue) at 0.26–0.3 (Ouija MUSIC.md: 'about 6 dB quieter… beds go about 2× higher').
Grip Tighter: the Suno cues are 3–4 dB quieter than the Reform (Lyria) cues, so their beds are 0.14–0.17.
Loudest cues (r_spirits_dark, w_aftermath, r_schools): keep at 0.12–0.14 (Ouija MUSIC.md).
Final mix is normalized by tools/master.py to −14 LUFS (two-pass loudnorm + limiter), so cues only need to balance against each other.
Measured integrated loudness: Lyria cues −10.7…−13.1 LUFS; ElevenLabs cues −12.8…−19.6 LUFS; raw Suno cues −14.7…−17.3 LUFS (r_spirits_dark, a mastered Suno cue, −12.1).

suno.mode: Custom, Instrumental ON. Paste the Styles text as written; paste the Exclude line into Exclude Styles.
suno.exclude_styles_bierce_and_ouija: vocals, choir, lyrics, drum kit, EDM, trap, pop, rock, synth lead, dubstep, rap
suno.exclude_styles_grip_tighter: vocals, choir, lyrics, humming, drum kit, EDM, trap, pop, rock, synth lead, dubstep, rap, gospel vocals, banjo, comedic, upbeat
suno.length: Suno makes 2+ minute tracks; that's fine — cues are cut, trimmed and faded to the narration (Ouija: anything 1:30 or longer).
suno.pick: Pick the take whose first 30–40 seconds already sound like the cue; most of each cue is built from its opening.
suno.delivery: MP3 (WAV if the plan has it), named as shown; drag into the chat or add to video/public/music/.
suno.ouija_cover_trick: Make the theme first (simplest, clearest tune in the first 20 s), then make every other cue as a Cover of that take (Remix/Edit → Cover) with new Styles text, so one melody returns in several arrangements.
suno.credit_line: Music: original cues generated with Suno, ElevenLabs and Google Lyria for 15 Minute History.
